### U7B: recognition quality did not produce a teaching intervention (2026-10-11)

U7B's frozen native Kev battery scored English 13/16, canonical 9/16 and combined 11/16, selecting the predeclared English fallback. In the teaching job, all eight panels of three competing valid grammar productions plus REVIEW selected REVIEW. Zero choices narrowed the reservoir; all 2,048 cross-stage exposures came from the broad deterministic fallback. No teacher benefit is established.

For a future #16 contract, require measurable intervention/exposure receipts separately from semantic-discrimination accuracy, and test a bounded pedagogical utility objective whose alternatives remain valid without a handpicked gold winner. Count review/fallback as no helper intervention and preserve it. Good source recognition is not curriculum intelligence. No frozen contract or prior negative is changed.

Detailed execution: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O0lxmLU7Jc49An-nh2YNpi-GkniLBFjf6pDN-PgGDh8/edit (R-08 / U7B). Draft PR and immutable evidence: https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/pull/112 ; `docs/evidence/u7b/RESULTS.md` and `run-01/shortcut-audit.json.gz`.

### U7B: combined context reversed the expected teacher-interface ranking (2026-10-11)

SAME eight source-grounded cells in two option orders: English 13/16; canonical 9/16; combined 11/16. Required reviews: 2/2, 0/2, 0/2. Joint two-step paths with independently validated intermediate state: 2/2, 0/2, 0/2. Option-order changes: 2/8, 2/8, 1/8. The frozen developmental rule selected English. Combined did not earn use. Paired cells and authored targets do not qualify general teacher competence; all eight downstream pedagogical choices abstained.

For future #65 qualification, keep workload-specific rendering comparisons, clarification/state metrics and complete byte/order/probability traces. Separate semantic correctness from actual scheduling influence/utility; do not standardize on richer bilingual context without matched evidence. Recover offered order from actual serialized HTTP bytes when canonical archive JSON sorts payload keys. Existing full comparator/calibration requirements remain open.

Detailed execution: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O0lxmLU7Jc49An-nh2YNpi-GkniLBFjf6pDN-PgGDh8/edit (R-08 / U7B). Draft PR and immutable evidence: https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/pull/112 ; `docs/evidence/u7b/RESULTS.md` and `run-01/shortcut-audit.json.gz`.

### U7B: causal witnesses did not prevent a curriculum shortcut (2026-10-11)

The exact 12/4/8/8 continuation completed 256 updates from U6 step 13,400. Cross-final accuracy rose 28/120 → 110/120, but AND was sampled only when both operands were TRUE and OR only when both were FALSE. A root-operator-only baseline scores 1,024/1,024 cross TRAIN and 120/120 cross final; the formal old/new NOT witnesses still change the answer. Frozen untrained sibling correctness fell 1,496/2,048 → 266/2,048. Boolean primitives fell 26/26 → 20/26; fresh U4 composites 13/32 → 2/32.

For a later #17 version, require distribution checks beyond formal causal influence: balance gate × operand truth × answer, freeze independent sibling holdouts before training and retain critical conservation as a separate promotion gate. The allocation is an implemented policy, not proven sufficient rehearsal. Preserve #111/U7 and U7B evidence. Correction requires a new version/freeze, not editing this run.

Detailed execution: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O0lxmLU7Jc49An-nh2YNpi-GkniLBFjf6pDN-PgGDh8/edit (R-08 / U7B). Draft PR and immutable evidence: https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/pull/112 ; `docs/evidence/u7b/RESULTS.md` and `run-01/shortcut-audit.json.gz`.

### U7B falsifier for #38: perfect operator-only label baseline (2026-10-11)

U7B inherited a generator setting root AND when both operands are TRUE and OR when both are FALSE. It passed independent oracle, type/codec and two-arm counterfactual tests, yet a predictor reading only the root operator scores 1,024/1,024 cross TRAIN and 120/120 cross final. Neural cross-final rose 28/120 → 110/120 while already-frozen untrained counterfactual-sibling correctness fell 1,496/2,048 → 266/2,048. The apparent gain does not establish learned composition.

Add this falsifier to the future pre-training auditor: operator/shape-only and operand-blind baselines, gate × operand truth × gold contingency tables and independently split/frozen sibling checks. A perfect structural cue must block integrity acceptance even with disjoint world IDs and formally active operands. This run is marked FAILED_PERFECT_ROOT_OPERATOR_LABEL_SHORTCUT, with no post-unblinding corpus repair or replacement training run.

Detailed execution: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O0lxmLU7Jc49An-nh2YNpi-GkniLBFjf6pDN-PgGDh8/edit (R-08 / U7B). Draft PR and immutable evidence: https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/pull/112 ; `docs/evidence/u7b/RESULTS.md` and `run-01/shortcut-audit.json.gz`.

### U7B: conservation failed within 256 pre-language updates (2026-10-11)

Continuing U6 to step 13,656 with exact 12/4/8/8 batches reduced Boolean primitives 26/26 → 20/26, historical U4 composites 50/128 → 22/128 and fresh U4 composites 13/32 → 2/32. Fresh U4 composite UNKNOWN 0/11, CONFLICT 0/6 and AMBIGUOUS 0/2 after continuation. The fixed lineage diagnostic remained 4/10. Pooled fresh varied/composite accuracy nevertheless rose 228/448 → 247/448; that gain conceals critical local losses. The cross-stage apparent gain also has a perfect gate-only shortcut.

For future #54 fingerprints, retain immutable critical primitive/evidence/lineage contrasts and family/label readouts as independent failure gates even when aggregate acquisition improves. Pre-language continuation is a needed interference/shortcut control for later language studies. Teacher-side English is not student language acquisition or evidence of language-specific forgetting. No promotion/conservation success is claimed.
